findings.title: Answered prayer as redirected course
findings.claim: The answered prayer is an active redirection: the response meets the request, turns the women's designed scheme away from Joseph, and leaves a changed route rather than simply erasing pressure.
findings.mechanism: The focus response carrier bears answering and fulfillment, صَرَفَ bears turning a direction or state, and كَيْدَ bears a deliberately arranged scheme. The supplied prison and later appointment connections return this contact through the focus action and show the danger losing its intended course while the surrounding route continues.
findings.reader_payoff: Protection becomes legible as a changed direction: the scheme does not get the outcome it was arranged to produce, even though the answer is not immediate ease.
findings.containment: This does not claim that confinement is itself harmless or beneficial, that the scheme disappears, or that every later event is mechanically caused by this ayah. It retains only the packet-supported diversion and changed route.

epistemic.reason: A citable cross-run publication directly binds the four focus branch references to the rerouting claim; later exact-Arabic connection targets are used only as contextual triggers without importing target-side morphology.

findings.title: An opening through pressure
findings.claim: The answered plea can be read as an opening through social pressure: the hostile arrangement remains the setting, but the response turns its force away from Joseph and leaves a route through it.
findings.mechanism: The answer carrier bears response to a prior call, while صَرَفَ bears turning a direction back. The later return to the unsettled scheme and the prison connection provide independent wider contact, making the opening a changed route through pressure rather than simple removal of the setting.
findings.reader_payoff: The concise answer becomes an enacted passage through danger: what surrounds Joseph is not denied, but it no longer determines the intended end.
findings.containment: This does not promote the older support's unlanded cutting/opening branch labels, does not call the pressure unreal, and does not claim that prison is itself the answer's only meaning.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk source is legacy_unbound and the target connections lack target morphology, but the focus carriers, exact target ayahs, and changed-course relation are supplied in the packet.

findings.title: Hearing joined to knowing
findings.claim: The closing hearing-and-knowing pair makes the response attentive to both what is voiced and what is understood behind the plea.
findings.mechanism: سَمِيع carries hearing as the focus carrier; the separate focus predicate at 12:34:10:2 supplies knowing, and the supplied 41:36 connection repeats the hearing-knowing closure amid hostile prompting. Their contact changes a generic answer into a response presented as informed by the spoken request and its condition.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing attributes explain why the answer can be fitted to a danger that is spoken as a plea but also carried by the surrounding situation.
findings.containment: This retains hearing as the carrier and uses knowing as the independent focus trigger; it does not invent target-side morphology for 41:36 or claim that an unanchored HFT description is lexical proof.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk evidence is legacy_unbound, while the focus words and exact 41:36 target are supplied; absent target morphology limits the wider comparison without removing the cross-root relation.

findings.title: Protection without immediate release
findings.claim: The focus's protection can coexist with continued confinement: the scheme is turned away from Joseph even as the next route still passes through prison and later public authority.
findings.mechanism: The focus diversion carrier is activated by the supplied 12:36 prison connection and the 12:54 appointment connection. Together they keep the threatened scheme's failed reach distinct from the persistence of hardship, changing the reading of protection from immediate release to guarded continuation.
findings.reader_payoff: The answer is no longer forced into a choice between protection and hardship; the packet makes both visible in one redirected route.
findings.containment: This does not call confinement benign, settle why the route takes that form, or assert that all later authority follows directly from the focus. It records the supported coexistence and sequence.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective source is legacy_unbound, but its prison-and-authority relation is independently connected to supplied exact target ayahs; target-side morphology remains outside the claim.

findings.reader_payoff: The answer's force lies in where the pressure is made to lead, not only in whether pressure is instantly removed.
findings.containment: This keeps the two supplied srf facets together without ranking them, does not claim that prison and appointment exhaust the route, and remains qualified because the supporting reader walk is legacy_unbound.

epistemic.reason: The wide reader-walk support is legacy_unbound, while the two exact target connections provide concrete contextual triggers for both supplied focus facets.
